# RapJumping.com

> Australia's home of Rap Jumping — guides, gear reviews, and stories about face-forward abseiling and rappelling.

Rap Jumping is a forward-facing form of abseiling pioneered in Australia in the late 1980s by Macka MacKail. This site covers the sport's history, technique, safety, gear, and locations across Australia.

## Key pages

- [About](https://www.rapjumping.com/about/): Who we are and the history of Rap Jumping in Australia
- [Blog](https://www.rapjumping.com/blog/): All guides, gear reviews, and how-tos
- [RSS Feed](https://www.rapjumping.com/rss.xml): Full content feed

## Content topics

- [Rap Jumping](https://www.rapjumping.com/tag/rap-jumping/): Face-forward abseiling — what it is, how to do it, where to try it
- [Abseiling](https://www.rapjumping.com/tag/abseiling/): Technique guides, safety, anchors, and rescue
- [Equipment](https://www.rapjumping.com/tag/equipment/): Gear reviews — harnesses, ropes, descenders, helmets
- [Safety](https://www.rapjumping.com/tag/safety/): Safety checklists, rescue procedures, and best practices
- [Australia](https://www.rapjumping.com/tag/australia/): Locations, tours, and operators across Australia
